title: Relative pronouns: who / which / that / where / whose / when / why

items.q: The developer ___ fixed the bug works at our company.

which: which es para cosas; developer es una persona: who (o that).
whose: whose = de quien (posesivo) y va antes de un sustantivo. Acá el pronombre es el sujeto de fixed: who.
where: where es para lugares; developer es una persona.

items.q: That's the tool ___ lets you track memory leaks.

who: who es para personas; tool es una cosa: which/that.
where: where es para lugares; un tool no es un lugar.
whose: whose es posesivo y va antes de un sustantivo; acá hace falta el sujeto de lets: which.

items.q: The office ___ we used to work has been renovated.

which: which reemplazaría a the office, pero falta la preposición (the office which we used to work in). Sin ella se usa where (= in which).
who: who es para personas; office es un lugar: where.
whose: whose es posesivo; no hay 'de quién' en la frase.

items.q: The project manager, ___ name I always forget, will join us later.

that: es una cláusula no definitoria (entre comas) y ahí no se usa that.
además necesitás un posesivo (the manager's name): whose.
who: who reemplaza al sujeto o al objeto. Acá el nombre es DEL manager (the manager's name): whose.
which: which es para cosas y no expresa posesión; hace falta whose (de la persona).

items.q: The app ___ interface is more intuitive is more popular.

which: which reemplaza una cosa, pero acá la interfaz es DE la app (the app's interface): whose. whose también se usa con cosas.
that: that no expresa posesión. the app's interface → whose interface.
who: who es para personas y no expresa posesión; app es una cosa: whose.

items.q: The library, ___ was built by the former government, is huge.
items.e: Non-defining (entre comas) → nunca that; cosa → which.

that: es una cláusula no definitoria (entre comas) y ahí no se usa that: which.
who: who es para personas; library es una cosa.
whose: whose es posesivo; no hay 'de quién' acá.

items.q: That was the moment ___ everything stopped working.

where: where es para lugares; moment es un momento: when.
why: why es para razones (the reason why).
which: which reemplazaría a un sujeto u objeto, pero la cláusula ya tiene sujeto (everything). Para un momento se usa when.

items.q: I don't know the reason ___ the build failed.

when: when es para momentos; reason pide why.
where: where es para lugares; reason pide why.
who: who es para personas; reason pide why.

items.q: She is the colleague ___ laptop I borrowed.

who: who reemplaza al sujeto u objeto. Acá el laptop es DEL colega (her laptop): whose.
which: which es para cosas y no expresa posesión; colleague es una persona: whose.
that: that no expresa posesión (de quién es el laptop): whose.

items.q: A browser is a program ___ lets you access the internet.

who: who es para personas; program es una cosa: that/which.
where: where es para lugares; un program no es un lugar.
whose: whose es posesivo y va antes de un sustantivo; acá hace falta el sujeto de lets: that.

title: ¿Se puede omitir el pronombre relativo?
instructions: Mirá lo que sigue al pronombre en negrita: ¿un verbo (es sujeto) o un sujeto nuevo (es objeto)?

items.q: The shirt **that** I bought was too expensive.
items.e: Después viene 'I' (sujeto propio) → that es objeto → se puede omitir.

No se puede omitir: that es el objeto de bought (el sujeto es I): se puede omitir → The shirt I bought.

items.q: She's the developer **who** fixed the bug.
items.e: Después viene un verbo → who es sujeto → no se omite.

Se puede omitir: who es el sujeto de fixed (viene directo el verbo): no se puede omitir.

items.q: The bug **that** she fixed was critical.

No se puede omitir: that es el objeto de fixed (el sujeto es she): se puede omitir → The bug she fixed.

items.q: The program **that** runs in the background is using too much memory.

Se puede omitir: that es el sujeto de runs (viene directo el verbo): no se puede omitir.

items.q: The framework **which** we use every day is Laravel.

No se puede omitir: which es el objeto de use (el sujeto es we): se puede omitir → The framework we use.

items.q: Mark Zuckerberg, **who** founded Facebook, wears grey T-shirts.
items.e: Non-defining: nunca se omite (y además who es sujeto).

Se puede omitir: who es el sujeto de founded, y además es una cláusula no definitoria (entre comas): nunca se omite.

title: Completá con el pronombre relativo
instructions: Escribí who / which / that / where / whose / when / why según corresponda.
text:
1. She is the person [1] looks after our networks.
2. It's a chip [2] controls a computer.
3. That's the man [3] dog bit me.
4. This is the place [4] I first learned Python.
5. The reason [5] he left was a mystery.
6. That was the year [6] they launched the app.
7. Python, [7] was created in 1991, is still very popular.
8. Mark, [8] is the founder of the company, always wears grey.

pat: which es para cosas; person es una persona: who (o that).
who es para personas; chip es una cosa: that/which.
el perro es DEL hombre (the man's dog): posesivo whose. who/which/that reemplazan un sujeto u objeto y no van antes de un sustantivo.
la cláusula I first learned Python ya tiene sujeto y verbo; falta un lugar, no un sujeto/objeto: where (= in which).
which no sirve acá: la cláusula ya tiene sujeto y verbo, no falta un sujeto ni un objeto.
items.altnote: Correcta con aviso: the reason that he left es inglés válido y común. En el ejercicio se busca la estructura con why: the reason why he left.

pat: which no sirve acá: la cláusula ya tiene sujeto y verbo, no falta un sujeto ni un objeto.
items.altnote: Correcta con aviso: the year that they launched es inglés válido y común. En el ejercicio se busca la estructura con when: the year when they launched.

pat: es una cláusula no definitoria (entre comas) y ahí no se usa that: which.
es una cláusula no definitoria (entre comas) y ahí no se usa that: who.

title: Definí términos IT con relative clauses
instructions: Completá cada definición con el pronombre relativo (who / that / which / where).
text:
1. A search bar: It's a tool [1] you type what you're looking for.
2. A printer: It's a device [2] prints documents.
3. A CPU: It's a chip [3] controls a computer.
4. A developer: It's a person [4] writes code.
5. A repository: It's a place [5] a project's code is stored.

pat: la cláusula you type what you're looking for ya tiene sujeto y verbo; falta un lugar (donde escribís): where (= in which).
items.e: Ejemplo de tus apuntes: 'a tool where you type...'.

pat: device es una cosa, no una persona (who) ni un lugar (where): that/which.
chip es una cosa, no una persona (who) ni un lugar (where): that/which.
which es para cosas; person es una persona: who (o that).
la cláusula a project's code is stored ya tiene sujeto y verbo; falta un lugar: where (= in which).

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: Mark Zuckerberg, that is the founder of Facebook, wears grey.
Mark Zuckerberg, who is the founder of Facebook, wears grey.
Mark Zuckerberg, which is the founder of Facebook, wears grey.
items.a: Mark Zuckerberg, who is the founder of Facebook, wears grey.
items.e: Non-defining: who/which, nunca that. Persona → who.

Mark Zuckerberg, that is the founder of: es una cláusula no definitoria (entre comas) y ahí no se usa that: who.
Mark Zuckerberg, which is the founder of: which es para cosas; Mark Zuckerberg es una persona: who.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: The person which called was rude.
The person who called was rude.
The person whose called was rude.
items.a: The person who called was rude.

which es para cosas; person es una persona: who.
whose es posesivo (de quién) y va antes de un sustantivo; acá es el sujeto de called: who.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: She is the developer who she fixed it.
She is the developer who fixed it.
She is the developer fixed it.
items.a: She is the developer who fixed it.
items.e: No se repite el sujeto; y who (sujeto) no se omite.

who ya es el sujeto de fixed; repetir she (y it) sobra: who fixed it.
who es el sujeto de fixed; acá no se puede omitir (sin él, la oración no tiene relativa).

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: The shirt which I bought it was expensive.
The shirt which I bought was expensive.
The shirt I bought it was expensive.
items.a: The shirt which I bought was expensive.

The shirt which I bought it was expensiv: which ya reemplaza al objeto; repetir it sobra: which I bought.
se puede omitir which (es objeto), pero repetir it sobra: The shirt I bought was expensive.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: Python, which was created in 1991, is popular.
Python, that was created in 1991, is popular.
Python, who was created in 1991, is popular.
items.a: Python, which was created in 1991, is popular.

Python, that was created in 1991, is pop: es una cláusula no definitoria (entre comas) y ahí no se usa that: which.
Python, who was created in 1991, is popu: who es para personas; Python es una cosa: which.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: The place where I went it was amazing.
The place where I went was amazing.
The place which I went was amazing.
items.a: The place where I went was amazing.
items.e: Lugar → where, y no se repite 'it'.

sobra it; ya tenés el sujeto The place: The place where I went was amazing.
which reemplazaría al lugar, pero falta la preposición (the place which I went to). Con where no hace falta.

title: Reduced relative clauses y participle clauses

items.q: There were lots of people ___ at the party.
items.e: who were dancing → dancing (participio presente, sentido activo).

danced: danced (participio pasado) sería pasivo: 'bailados'. La gente baila (activo): people dancing.
who dancing: who necesita un verbo conjugado (who were dancing). Si se reduce, se quita who y queda dancing.
are dancing: people are dancing ya es una oración completa; acá queda una cláusula reducida sin who ni were.

items.q: The developer ___ on this feature is very experienced.

works: works sería un segundo verbo conjugado junto a is; falta el conector who (the developer who works...).
worked: worked (participio) sería pasivo: 'trabajado'. El developer trabaja (activo): working.
who working: who necesita un verbo conjugado (who is working). Si se reduce, se quita who y queda working.

items.q: The presents ___ to the children are all hand-made.
items.e: which are given → given (participio pasado, sentido pasivo).

giving: giving sería activo: 'que dan'. Los regalos son dados (pasivo): given.
gave: gave sería un verbo conjugado sin conector (who/that). Reducida pasiva: given.
who given: who given no existe; la reducida pasiva es sólo given (o that are given).

items.q: Decisions ___ in a rush are often regretted later.

making: making sería activo: 'que hacen'. Las decisiones son tomadas (pasivo): made.
make: make sería un verbo conjugado sin conector (that/which).
are making: are making es activo y además sobra el verbo conjugado; las decisiones son tomadas: made.

items.q: The files ___ in the folder are old.
items.e: Los archivos son almacenados → participio pasado.

storing: storing sería activo: 'que guardan'. Los archivos son guardados (pasivo): stored.
store: store sería un verbo conjugado sin conector (that/which).
to store: to store expresa propósito; acá describe lo que está guardado: stored.

items.q: The team ___ the release is under pressure.
items.e: who is preparing → preparing (el equipo hace la acción).

prepared: prepared sería pasivo: 'preparado'. El equipo prepara el release (activo): preparing.
prepare: prepare sería un verbo conjugado sin conector (who prepares).
prepares: prepares es un verbo conjugado junto a is; falta el conector who (the team who prepares...).

items.q: ___ very tired, they decided to go straight home.
items.e: Participle clause de razón (as they were tired).

Felt: felt (participio) sería pasivo. El sujeto they siente el cansancio a la vez que decide: Feeling (acción simultánea).
To feel: To feel expresa propósito ('para sentir'), no causa ni simultaneidad: Feeling.
Feels: feels es un verbo conjugado; al comienzo necesitás una cláusula participial sin sujeto: Feeling.

items.q: ___ the coat, she asked her friend's opinion.

Before buy: después de la preposición before va -ing: Before buying.
Before to buy: después de before no va to + verbo; va -ing: Before buying.
Before bought: después de before va -ing, no el pasado: Before buying.
